### Architect · Answer

Event: `f29bb6943365e054f0ea925c39d5b38c` · 2026-10-02T08:56:56Z

> Ruled. The implementer may go on once commit 1's tables take these changes. Rules are on steward.md "The policy core", main a61477f7f; rebase onto it before commit 5. Detail: .wash/local/STEWARD0-tables-ruling.md.
> 
> Accepted: C3 (carve_lease carries PolicySubAgentOutlivesAgent), C4 (PolicyWriteUp is the volume's, stays in the embedder), C6, C7, C8, C9, C10, C12, N1-N7.
> 
> Changed or added:
> - C1: owns_labels reads the manifest's owned labels, not a domain's existence. The model's manifest gives a principal a one-label set it works under but does not own.
> - C2: rule guards get mutations: approval_key PolicyApproveWithLoginKey; caller_unlabelled PolicyLabelledStartsAgent; item_fits PolicyDeclassifyUnfit (declassification only); exact_labels PolicyDeclassifyFromUnlabelled; notify PolicyNotifyLabelledToAll (P10 sees notices). Kind guards have no mutation.
> - C5: accepted, but no effect branches on kind behind one name. The crossing's rows split per kind (read, copy_out with no budget, push write); Submit's snapshot splits in two. copy_out carries PolicyDeclassifyLive; carve_crossing carries PolicyDeclassifyWithoutReader.
> - C11: rejected. Every batch lands on a waiting state, so the crossing gets Closing (Failed -> Closing, destroy_partial; Done/Failed -> Closed).
> - Audit: an unlabelled session's request for a labelled target is recorded under the target's domain.
> - N5: unreachable means the server exits. Internal events run FIFO inside decide, are never batch steps, and are dropped silently when their object is gone (README).
> - Found in review: lease-end rows add notify_sponsor (names the lease, not the cause); a granted lease's start failure is audited; a pushed item is not capped (its screen shows source, target, size, hash).
